name: tewake
title: Tewake
description: See what this computer is running for your Tewake fleet, and stop or resume accepting new jobs.
author: genm

commands.name: status
commands.title: Node Status
commands.subtitle: Tewake
commands.description: Show whether this computer accepts new fleet jobs and what it is running.

commands.name: pause
commands.title: Stop Accepting Jobs
commands.subtitle: Tewake
commands.description: Withhold this computer's capacity without cancelling the job already running.

commands.name: resume
commands.title: Resume Accepting Jobs
commands.subtitle: Tewake
commands.description: Offer this computer's capacity again once the controller confirms it.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Tewake CLI
preferences.description: Path to the tewake binary. Leave empty to search the standard install locations.

preferences.name: stateDirectory
preferences.title: Agent State Directory
preferences.description: Override the agent state directory when it is not the OS default.
